description: This file defines a PHP trait PayloadParserTrait that provides methods for parsing JSON and XML payloads within the AWS SDK's API parsing machinery. It handles errors and exceptions related to payload parsing and is used internally in the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string, throws an exception if parsing fails, returns the decoded array.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses an XML string into a SimpleXMLElement, throws an exception if parsing fails.
